notes: Four localized manipulation episodes are visible. The same side door is opened and closed twice in clearly separated approach-manipulate-withdraw cycles, so these are retained as separate events. Surveying/circling portions were not counted.
scene_description: A user circles a parked blue Toyota Supra in an outdoor parking lot, twice operates a side door, then opens and closes the front hood, and finally opens and closes the rear hatch.
